name: Noosphere C2PA
description: Optional provenance signer for Spotlight case packages using C2PA Content Credentials. Requires a Noosphere signing API key (X-API-Key); a signing credential is configured on the signer.
rate_limit_note: Requires a Noosphere signing API key (X-API-Key with 'sign' scope) via NOOSPHERE_PROVENANCE_API_KEY. Signing availability and credential policy are controlled by the Noosphere C2PA signer deployment.
